tools.name: 7shifts_whoami
tools.description: Show the identity behind the connected 7shifts access token. First call to check the connection. 7shifts API: GET /v2/whoami.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies the access token can read (one for a single-company token). 7shifts API: GET /v2/companies.

tools.name: 7shifts_get_company
tools.description: Get one company: plan status, expiry, country, start-of-week and POS type. 7shifts API: GET /v2/companies/{id}.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_locations
tools.description: List the company's locations (restaurants or sites). Use the ids in other tools. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/locations.

tools.name: 7shifts_get_location
tools.description: Get one location by id, with its settings. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/locations/{location_id}.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_departments
tools.description: List departments, optionally for one location. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/departments.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_roles
tools.description: List job roles (positions), optionally for one location or department. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/roles.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_inactive_reasons
tools.description: List the reasons used to deactivate an employee. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/inactive_reasons.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_users
tools.description: List employees (users) with their role, location and department ids. Filter by status (active or inactive) or name. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/users.

tools.name: 7shifts_get_user
tools.description: Get one employee by id, with profile fields. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/users/{identifier}.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_user_assignments
tools.description: List the locations, departments and roles one employee is assigned to. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/users/{user_id}/assignments.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_shifts
tools.description: List scheduled shifts, filtered by time window, location, department, role or employee. Use start and end bounds for a date range. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/shifts.

tools.name: 7shifts_get_shift
tools.description: Get one shift by id. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/shifts/{shift_id}.

tools.name: 7shifts_list_time_punches
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out records (time punches), filtered by employee, location, role, approval or clock time. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/time_punches.

tools.name: 7shifts_get_time_punch
tools.description: Get one time punch by id. 7shifts API: GET /v2/company/{company_id}/time_punches/{time_punch_id}.
